items.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
items.tr:
I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the outcast. اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ [Full-verse context (2:255):
Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living,[98] the Self-Sustaining.[99] Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[100] and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī[101] extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High,[102] the Most Great.[103]
[98] Whose life is perfect, complete and eternal, without beginning or end, and through whom all created life originated and continues.
[99] Dependent on none for His existence while being the sustainer and administrator of all created existence.
[100] Allāh's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.
[101] Chair or footstool. It is not to be confused with al-ʿArsh (the Throne) , which is infinitely higher and greater than al-Kursī.
[102] Above all of His creations and superior to them in essence, rank and position.
[103] Whose greatness is unlimited, beyond description or imagination.].

items.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾.  بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾.  بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tr:
In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ [Full-verse context (112:1):
Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,[2011]
[2011] Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.

Full-verse context (112:2):
Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.[2012]
[2012] He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.

Full-verse context (112:3):
He neither begets nor is born,

Full-verse context (112:4):
Nor is there to Him any equivalent."]. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ [Full-verse context (113:1):
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

Full-verse context (113:2):
From the evil of that which He created

Full-verse context (113:3):
And from the evil of darkness when it settles

Full-verse context (113:4):
And from the evil of the blowers in knots[2014]
[2014] i.e., those who practice magic.

Full-verse context (113:5):
And from the evil of an envier when he envies."]. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ [Full-verse context (114:1):
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:2):
The Sovereign of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:3):
The God of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:4):
From the evil of the retreating whisperer[2016] -
[2016] i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.

Full-verse context (114:5):
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

Full-verse context (114:6):
From among the jinn and mankind."[2017]
[2017] Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.]. (Three times.)

items.ar: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي  هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ)). [ وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه] [وإذا أمسى قال: رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها.]
items.tr: We have entered the morning, and all dominion belongs to Allah. All praise belongs to Allah. None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what follows it, and seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evils of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave. [In the evening say: We have entered the evening, and all dominion belongs to Allah.] [In the evening say: My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and what follows it, and seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and what follows it.]
items.translit: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir. Rabbi asaluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma badah, wa audhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa sharri ma badah. Rabbi audhu bika minal-kasali wa suil-kibar. Rabbi audhu bika min adhabin fin-nari wa adhabin fil-qabr. [Evening: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah. Rabbi asaluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa khayra ma badaha, wa audhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa sharri ma badaha.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا ، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم بك أمسينا، وبك أصبحنا، وبك نحيا، وبك نموت، وإليك المصير.]
items.tr: O Allah, through You we enter the morning and evening, through You we live and die, and to You is the resurrection. [In the evening say: O Allah, through You we enter the evening and morning, through You we live and die, and to You is the final return.]
items.translit: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur. [Evening: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykal-masir.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, You are my Lord; none is worthy of worship except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I remain upon my covenant and promise to You as far as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and confess my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.translit: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana abduk, wa ana ala ahdika wa wadika mastatat, audhu bika min sharri ma sanat, abuu laka binimatika alayya, wa abuu bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ)) (أربعَ مَرَّاتٍ).[ وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم إني أمسيت...]
items.tr: O Allah, this morning I call You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation to witness that You are Allah; none is worthy of worship except You alone, without partner, and Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger. (Four times.) [In the evening say: O Allah, this evening I call You to witness …]
items.translit: Allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka wa ushhidu hamalata arshika wa malaikataka wa jamia khalqik, annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna Muhammadan abduka wa rasuluk. [Four times. Evening: Allahumma inni amsaytu ...]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي...]
items.tr: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or any of Your creation this morning is from You alone, without partner. To You belongs all praise and all thanks. [In the evening say: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me this evening …]
items.translit: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min nimatin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr. [Evening: Allahumma ma amsa bi ...]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ  إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tr: O Allah, grant health to my body. O Allah, grant health to my hearing. O Allah, grant health to my sight. None is worthy of worship except You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and from the punishment of the grave. None is worthy of worship except You. (Three times.)
items.translit: Allahumma afini fi badani, Allahumma afini fi sami, Allahumma afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant. Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa audhu bika min adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant. [Three times.]

items.ar: ((حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ)) (سَبْعَ مَرّاتٍ).
items.tr:
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ [Full-verse context (9:129):
But if they turn away, [O Muḥammad], say, "Sufficient for me is Allāh; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne."]. (Seven times.)
items.translit: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-arshil-azim. [Seven times.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي)).
items.tr: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, worldly life, family and wealth. O Allah, conceal my vulnerabilities and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me, behind me, to my right, to my left and above me. I seek refuge in Your greatness from being destroyed from beneath me.
items.translit: Allahumma inni asalukal-afwa wal-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni asalukal-afwa wal-afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur awrati wa amin rawati. Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa an yamini wa an shimali wa min fawqi, wa audhu bi-azamatika an ughtala min tahti.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى  نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ)).
items.tr: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and seen, Originator of the heavens and earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything, I bear witness that none is worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul, from the evil of Satan and his snares, and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
items.translit: Allahumma alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wa malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, audhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaytani wa sharakih, wa an aqtarifa ala nafsi suan aw ajurrahu ila Muslim.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ)).
items.tr: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and seen, Originator of the heavens and earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything, I bear witness that none is worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul, from the evil of Satan and his snares, and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
items.translit: Allahumma alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadati fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wa malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, audhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaytani wa sharakih, wa an aqtarifa ala nafsi suan aw ajurrahu ila Muslim.

items.ar: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tr: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm. He is As-Sami (the All-Hearing), Al-Alim (the All-Knowing). (Three times.)
items.translit: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru maasmihi shayun fil-ardi wa la fis-samai wa huwas-Samiul-Alim. [Three times.]

items.ar: ((رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّاً)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tr: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, as my Prophet. (Three times.)
items.translit: Raditu billahi rabban wa bil-Islami dinan wa bi-Muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallama nabiyya. [Three times.]

items.ar: ((يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ)).
items.tr: Ya Hayy (Ever-Living), Ya Qayyum (Sustainer of all), through Your mercy I seek help. Set all my affairs right, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
items.translit: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu birahmatika astaghith, aslih li shani kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn.

items.ar: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ:فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه ربّ العالمين اللَّهم إني أسألك خير هذه الليلة: فتحها، ونصرها، ونورها، وبركتها، وهداها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيها، وشر ما بعدها.]
items.tr: We have entered the morning, and all dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its openings, victory, light, blessing and guidance. I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what follows it. [In the evening say: We have entered the evening, and all dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its openings, victory, light, blessing and guidance. I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what follows it.]
items.translit: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-alamin. Allahumma inni asaluka khayra hadhal-yawmi fathahu wa nasrahu wa nurahu wa barakatahu wa hudah, wa audhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma badah. [Evening: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-alamin. Allahumma inni asaluka khayra hadhihil-laylati fathaha wa nasraha wa nuraha wa barakataha wa hudaha, wa audhu bika min sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma badaha.]

items.ar: ((أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ)). [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام...]
items.tr: We have entered the morning upon the fitrah (natural disposition) of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright, a Muslim, and not among the polytheists. [In the evening say: We have entered the evening upon the fitrah of Islam …]
items.translit: Asbahna ala fitratil-Islami wa ala kalimatil-ikhlasi wa ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, wa ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan Musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin. [Evening: Amsayna ala fitratil-Islam ...]

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ)) (مائة مرَّةٍ).
items.tr: Glory and praise be to Allah. (One hundred times.)
items.translit: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih. [One hundred times.]

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) (عشرَ مرَّات) ، أَوْ (مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. (Ten times, or once when feeling lazy.)
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir. [Ten times, or once when feeling lazy.]

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) (مائةَ مرَّةٍ إذا أصبحَ).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. (One hundred times in the morning.)
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir. [One hundred times in the morning.]

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أصبحَ).
items.tr: Glory and praise be to Allah, as numerous as His creation, to His own satisfaction, as weighty as His Throne, and as abundant as the ink of His words. (Three times in the morning.)
items.translit: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, adada khalqih, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata arshih, wa midada kalimatih. [Three times in the morning.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً)) (إذا أصبحَ).
items.tr: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision and accepted deeds. (In the morning.)
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka ilman nafian wa rizqan tayyiban wa amalan mutaqabbala. [In the morning.]

items.ar: ((أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ)) (مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ).
items.tr: I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him. (One hundred times a day.)
items.translit: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh. [One hundred times a day.]

items.ar: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أمسى).
items.tr: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He created. (Three times in the evening.)
items.translit: Audhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq. [Three times in the evening.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ)) (عشرَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tr: O Allah, bless our Prophet Muhammad and grant him peace. (Ten times.)
items.translit: Allahumma salli wa sallim ala nabiyyina Muhammad. [Ten times.]

items.ar: ((يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا:بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾.  بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾.  بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ)) (يفعلُ ذلك ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tr:
He brings his palms together, then blows lightly into them and recites into them: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ [Full-verse context (112:1):
Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,[2011]
[2011] Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.

Full-verse context (112:2):
Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.[2012]
[2012] He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.

Full-verse context (112:3):
He neither begets nor is born,

Full-verse context (112:4):
Nor is there to Him any equivalent."]. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ [Full-verse context (113:1):
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

Full-verse context (113:2):
From the evil of that which He created

Full-verse context (113:3):
And from the evil of darkness when it settles

Full-verse context (113:4):
And from the evil of the blowers in knots[2014]
[2014] i.e., those who practice magic.

Full-verse context (113:5):
And from the evil of an envier when he envies."]. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ [Full-verse context (114:1):
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:2):
The Sovereign of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:3):
The God of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:4):
From the evil of the retreating whisperer[2016] -
[2016] i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.

Full-verse context (114:5):
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

Full-verse context (114:6):
From among the jinn and mankind."[2017]
[2017] Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.]. Then he wipes as much of his body as he can with them, beginning with his head, his face and the front of his body. (He does this three times.)

items.ar: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْـــــــــــدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
items.tr:
Full-verse context (2:255):
Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living,[98] the Self-Sustaining.[99] Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[100] and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī[101] extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High,[102] the Most Great.[103]
[98] Whose life is perfect, complete and eternal, without beginning or end, and through whom all created life originated and continues.
[99] Dependent on none for His existence while being the sustainer and administrator of all created existence.
[100] Allāh's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.
[101] Chair or footstool. It is not to be confused with al-ʿArsh (the Throne) , which is infinitely higher and greater than al-Kursī.
[102] Above all of His creations and superior to them in essence, rank and position.
[103] Whose greatness is unlimited, beyond description or imagination.

items.ar: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.
items.tr:
Full-verse context (2:285):
The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allāh and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination."

Full-verse context (2:286):
Allāh does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."[111]
[111] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) concludes this sūrah by directing His servants how to supplicate Him, just as He taught them in Sūrah al-Fātiḥah how to praise Him and ask for guidance.

items.ar: ((بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ)).
items.tr: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and through You I raise it. If You keep my soul, have mercy on it; if You release it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
items.translit: Bismika rabbi wadatu janbi wa bika arfauh, fa in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi ibadakas-salihin.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, You created my soul, and You take it in death. Its death and life belong to You. If You give it life, protect it; if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.
items.translit: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsi wa anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wa mahyaha, in ahyaytaha fahfazha wa in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma inni asalukal-afiyah.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.
items.translit: Allahumma qini adhabaka yawma tabathu ibadak.

items.ar: ((بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا)).
items.tr: In Your name, O Allah, I die and live.
items.translit: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ))).
items.tr: Glory be to Allah (thirty-three times); all praise belongs to Allah (thirty-three times); Allah is greatest (thirty-four times).
items.translit: Subhanallah [thirty-three times], walhamdu lillah [thirty-three times], wallahu akbar [thirty-four times].

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the earth, Lord of the mighty Throne, our Lord and Lord of everything, Splitter of grain and date stones, Revealer of At-Tawrah, Al-Injil and Al-Furqan, I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are Al-Awwal (the First), with nothing before You; Al-Akhir (the Last), with nothing after You; Az-Zahir (the Most High), with nothing above You; and Al-Batin (the Inward), with nothing nearer than You. Settle our debt and spare us poverty.
items.translit: Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabi wa rabbal-ardi wa rabbal-arshil-azim, rabbana wa rabba kulli shay, faliqal-habbi wan-nawa, wa munzilat-Tawrati wal-Injili wal-Furqan, audhu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhidhun binasiyatih. Allahumma antal-Awwalu falaysa qablaka shay, wa antal-Akhiru falaysa badaka shay, wa antaz-Zahiru falaysa fawqaka shay, wa antal-Batinu falaysa dunaka shay, iqdi annad-dayna wa aghnina minal-faqr.

items.ar: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ)).
items.tr: All praise belongs to Allah, who fed us, gave us drink, sufficed us and sheltered us. How many have none to suffice or shelter them!
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi atamana wa saqana wa kafana wa awana, fa kam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la muwi.

items.ar: ((يَقْرَأُ ﴿الم﴾ تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَة ِ،  وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ)).
items.tr:
He recites الم [Full-verse context (32:1):
Alif, Lām, Meem.[1170]
[1170] See footnote to 2:1.], Tanzil As-Sajdah, and تَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ [Full-verse context (67:1):
Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -].

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affairs to You, turn my face to You, and rest my back in reliance upon You, desiring You and fearing You. There is no refuge or escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and Your Prophet whom You sent.
items.translit: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa aljatu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta wa binabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.

items.ar: ( الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ )
items.tr: All praise belongs to Allah, who brought us to life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana bada ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.

items.ar: ( لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي ).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. Glory be to Allah; all praise belongs to Allah; none is worthy of worship except Allah; Allah is greatest. There is no power or strength except through Allah, Al-Ali (the Most High), Al-Azim (the Magnificent). My Lord, forgive me.
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir. Subhanallah, walhamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-Aliyyil-Azim. Rabbighfir li.

items.ar: ( الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ )
items.tr: All praise belongs to Allah, who granted my body well-being, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi afani fi jasadi wa radda alayya ruhi wa adhina li bidhikrih.

items.ar: ﴿ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴾
items.tr:
Full-verse context (3:190):
Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding -

Full-verse context (3:191):
Who remember Allāh while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

Full-verse context (3:192):
Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.

Full-verse context (3:193):
Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die among the righteous.

Full-verse context (3:194):
Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise."

Full-verse context (3:195):
And their Lord responded to them, "Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allāh, and Allāh has with Him the best reward."

Full-verse context (3:196):
Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land.

Full-verse context (3:197):
[It is but] a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.

Full-verse context (3:198):
But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allāh. And that which is with Allāh is best for the righteous.

Full-verse context (3:199):
And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allāh and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allāh. They do not exchange the verses of Allāh for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.

Full-verse context (3:200):
O you who have believed, persevere[152] and endure[153] and remain stationed[154] and fear Allāh that you may be successful.
[152] In your religion and in the face of your enemies.
[153] In patience, outlasting your enemies, and against your own evil inclinations.
[154] Posted at your positions against the enemy or in the mosques, awaiting prayers.
