items.ar: ([بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث).
items.tr: [In Allah's name.] O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.
items.translit: [Bismillah.] Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khabaith.

items.ar: (غُفْرَانَكَ).
items.tr: I seek Your forgiveness.
items.translit: Ghufranak.

items.ar: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).
items.tr: In Allah's name.
items.translit: Bismillah.

items.ar: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).
items.tr: In Allah's name.
items.translit: Bismillah.

items.ar: (أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ..).
items.tr: I bear witness that none is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger …
items.translit: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh ...

items.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ)
items.tr: O Allah, make me among those who frequently repent, and among those who purify themselves.
items.translit: Allahummaj alni minat-tawwabina waj alni minal-mutatahhirin.

items.ar: (سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ).
items.tr: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. I bear witness that none is worthy of worship except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
items.translit: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.

items.ar: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).
items.tr: In Allah's name. I place my trust in Allah. There is no power or strength except through Allah.
items.translit: Bismillah, tawakkaltu alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

items.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from going astray or being led astray, slipping or being made to slip, wronging or being wronged, and acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu bika an adilla aw udall, aw azilla aw uzall, aw azlima aw uzlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala alayy.

items.ar: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ).
items.tr: In Allah's name we enter, and in Allah's name we leave, and in Allah, our Lord, we place our trust. Then let him greet his family with salam (peace).
items.translit: Bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi kharajna wa alallahi rabbina tawakkalna. [Then greet your family.]

items.ar: (اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُوراً، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُوراً، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُوراً، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُوراً، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُوراً، وَعَظِّم لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُوراً، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُوراً، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُوراً، وَفِي دَمِي نُوراً، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُوراً، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُوراً)([اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً فِي قَبْرِي... وَنُوراً فِي عِظَامِي])[(وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً، وَزِدْنِي نُوراً)][(وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً عَلَى نُورٍ)]
items.tr: O Allah, place light in my heart, tongue, hearing and sight; above me and beneath me; to my right and left; before me and behind me. Place light within me; make light great for me, make light great for me; grant me light and make me light. O Allah, give me light. Place light in my sinews, flesh, blood, hair and skin. [O Allah, place light for me in my grave … and light in my bones.] [Increase me in light; increase me in light; increase me in light.] [Grant me light upon light.]
items.translit: Allahummaj al fi qalbi nuran, wa fi lisani nuran, wa fi sami nuran, wa fi basari nuran, wa min fawqi nuran, wa min tahti nuran, wa an yamini nuran, wa an shimali nuran, wa min amami nuran, wa min khalfi nuran, waj al fi nafsi nuran, wa azim li nuran, wa azzim li nuran, waj al li nuran, waj alni nuran. Allahumma atini nuran, waj al fi asabi nuran, wa fi lahmi nuran, wa fi dami nuran, wa fi shari nuran, wa fi bashari nuran. [Allahummaj al li nuran fi qabri ... wa nuran fi izami.] [Wa zidni nuran, wa zidni nuran, wa zidni nuran.] [Wa hab li nuran ala nur.]

items.ar: (يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُمْنَى) ، وَيَقُولُ: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ))  [بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ] [وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ]  ((اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ)).
items.tr: Begin with the right foot and say: 'I seek refuge in Allah, Al-Azim (the Magnificent), in His noble Face and His eternal authority, from Satan the accursed.' [In Allah's name, and blessings] [and peace be upon Allah's Messenger.] 'O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.'
items.translit: [Enter with the right foot.] Audhu billahil-Azim, wa biwajhihil-karim, wa sultanihil-qadim, minash-shaytanir-rajim. [Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu ala rasulillah.] Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.

items.ar: ((يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُسْرَى))  وَيَقُولُ: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)).
items.tr: Begin with the left foot and say: 'In Allah's name, and blessings and peace be upon Allah's Messenger. O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from Satan the accursed.'
items.translit: [Leave with the left foot.] Bismillahi was-salatu was-salamu ala rasulillah. Allahumma inni asaluka min fadlik. Allahummasimni minash-shaytanir-rajim.

items.ar: يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ المُؤَذِّنُ إِلاَّ فِي ((حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ وَحَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ)) فَيقُولُ: ((لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
items.tr: Repeat what the muadhdhin (caller to prayer) says, except at 'Come to prayer; come to success,' when you say: 'There is no power or strength except through Allah.'
items.translit: [Repeat the caller except at Hayya alas-salah and Hayya alal-falah, when you say:] La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

items.ar: يَقُولُ: ((وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِينَاً)) ((يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ عَقِبَ تَشَهُّدِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ)).
items.tr: Say: 'I too bear witness that none is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Muhammad as Messenger and Islam as religion.' Say this after the muadhdhin's testimonies of faith.
items.translit: Wa ana ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh, raditu billahi rabban wa bi-Muhammadin rasulan wa bil-Islami dina. [Say after the caller's testimonies.]

items.ar: ((يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ فَرَاغِهِ مِنْ إِجَابَةِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ)).
items.tr: Invoke blessings upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, after finishing your response to the muadhdhin (caller to prayer).

items.ar: يَقُولُ: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامَاً مَحمُوداً الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، [إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ])).
items.tr: Say: 'O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established salah (prayer), grant Muhammad al-Wasilah (the special rank in Paradise) and excellence, and raise him to the praised station You have promised him. [You never break Your promise.]'
items.translit: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-dawatit-tammati was-salatil-qaimah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wabathu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi waadtah. [Innaka la tukhliful-miad.]

items.ar: ((يَدْعُو لِنَفسِهِ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ فَإِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ حِينَئِذٍ لاَ يُرَدُّ)).
items.tr: Supplicate for yourself between the adhan (call to prayer) and iqamah (call to begin prayer), for supplication then is not rejected.

items.ar: (الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة...)
items.tr: All praise belongs to Allah, who clothed me in this garment and provided it for me without power or strength on my part …
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha ath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah ...

items.ar: ( اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ).
items.tr: O Allah, all praise belongs to You; You have clothed me in it. I ask You for its good and the good of what it was made for, and seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what it was made for.
items.translit: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanih, asaluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma sunia lah, wa audhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma sunia lah.

items.ar: (تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى)
items.tr: May you wear it out, and may Allah Most High replace it for you.
items.translit: Tubli wa yukhlifullahu taala.

items.ar: (اِلْبَسْ جَدِيداً وَعِشْ حَمِيداً وَمُتْ شَهِيداً).
items.tr: Wear new clothing, live a praiseworthy life and die a martyr.
items.translit: Ilbas jadidan wa ish hamidan wa mut shahida.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْني مِنْ خَطَايَايَ، بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْماءِ وَالْبَرَدِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the east from the west. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. O Allah, wash me of my sins with snow, water and hail.
items.translit: Allahumma baid bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama baadta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allahumma naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas. Allahummaghsilni min khatayaya bith-thalji wal-mai wal-barad.

items.ar: ((سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)).
items.tr: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and none is worthy of worship besides You.
items.translit: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdik, wa tabarakasmuk, wa taala jadduk, wa la ilaha ghayruk.

items.ar: ((وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفَاً وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلاَتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ، وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ المَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبي جَمِيعَاً إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِها إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَـــــــدَيْكَ، وَالشَّـــــرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْــــــكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ)).
items.tr:
وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفَاً وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلاَتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ، وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ [Full-verse context (6:79):
Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."

Full-verse context (6:162):
Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

Full-verse context (6:163):
No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."[361]
[361] i.e., those who submit to the will of Allāh.]. O Allah, You are the King; none deserves worship except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant. I have wronged myself and acknowledged my sin, so forgive all my sins, for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best character; none guides to its best except You. Turn its evil away from me; none turns its evil away from me except You. Here I am, responding to You and serving You. All good is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You. I exist through You and return to You. Blessed and exalted are You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
items.translit: Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhi fataras-samawati wal-arda hanifan wa ma ana minal-mushrikin, inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi rabbil-alamin, la sharika lahu wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana minal-Muslimin. Allahumma antal-maliku la ilaha illa ant, anta rabbi wa ana abduk, zalamtu nafsi wataraftu bidhanbi faghfir li dhunubi jamian innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant. Wahdini li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdi li-ahsaniha illa ant, wasrif anni sayyiaha la yasrifu anni sayyiaha illa ant. Labbayka wa sadayk, wal-khayru kulluhu biyadayk, wash-sharru laysa ilayk, ana bika wa ilayk, tabarakta wa taalayt, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ، وَمِيْكَائِيلَ، وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ. اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقيمٍ)).
items.tr: O Allah, Lord of Jibrail, Mikail and Israfil, Originator of the heavens and earth, Knower of the unseen and seen, You judge between Your servants in their disagreements. By Your permission, guide me to the truth in that over which they differ. You guide whom You will to a straight path.
items.translit: Allahumma rabba Jibraila wa Mikaila wa Israfil, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, anta tahkumu bayna ibadika fima kanu fihi yakhtalifun. Ihdini limakhtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi-idhnik, innaka tahdi man tashau ila siratin mustaqim.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرَاً، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً)) ثَلاثاً ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ: مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَهَمْزِهِ)).
items.tr: Allah is supremely great; Allah is supremely great; Allah is supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah; abundant praise belongs to Allah; abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah morning and evening. (Three times.) I seek refuge in Allah from Satan: his arrogance, his poetry and his incitement to madness.
items.translit: Allahu akbaru kabira, Allahu akbaru kabira, Allahu akbaru kabira, walhamdu lillahi kathira, walhamdu lillahi kathira, walhamdu lillahi kathira, wa subhanallahi bukratan wa asila. [Three times.] Audhu billahi minash-shaytan, min nafkhihi wa nafthihi wa hamzih.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَواتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ] [وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ] [أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقاؤُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَقٌّ، وَالسّاعَةُ حَقٌّ] [اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حاكَمْتُ. فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ] [وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي] [أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ] [أَنْتَ إِلَهِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ] [وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ])).
items.tr: O Allah, all praise belongs to You. You are the light of the heavens, earth and all within them. All praise belongs to You; You sustain the heavens, earth and all within them. [All praise belongs to You; You are the Lord of the heavens, earth and all within them.] [All praise belongs to You; Yours is the dominion of the heavens, earth and all within them.] [All praise belongs to You; You are the King of the heavens and earth.] [All praise belongs to You.] [You are the Truth; Your promise, Your word and meeting You are true. Paradise, the Fire, the prophets, Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and the Hour are true.] [O Allah, to You I submit, upon You I rely, in You I believe, to You I turn, by You I contend, and to You I refer for judgment. Forgive me what I have done before and what I do later, what I conceal and what I disclose] [and what You know better than I.] [You are Al-Muqaddim (the One who brings forward), Al-Muakhkhir (the One who puts back); none is worthy of worship except You.] [You are my God; none is worthy of worship except You.] [There is no power or strength except through Allah.]
items.translit: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta nurus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu anta qayyimus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn. [Wa lakal-hamdu anta rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn.] [Wa lakal-hamdu laka mulkus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn.] [Wa lakal-hamdu anta malikus-samawati wal-ard.] [Wa lakal-hamd.] [Antal-haqqu wa wadukal-haqqu wa qawlukal-haqqu wa liqaukal-haqq, wal-jannatu haqq, wan-naru haqq, wan-nabiyyuna haqq, wa Muhammadun sallallahu alayhi wa sallama haqq, was-sa atu haqq.] [Allahumma laka aslamtu wa alayka tawakkaltu wa bika amantu wa ilayka anabtu wa bika khasamtu wa ilayka hakamtu, faghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma alant.] [Wa ma anta alamu bihi minni.] [Antal-Muqaddimu wa antal-Muakhkhiru la ilaha illa ant.] [Anta ilahi la ilaha illa ant.] [Wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.]

items.ar: ((سُبْحانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ)). ثلاث مرَّاتٍ.
items.tr: Glory be to my Lord, Al-Azim (the Magnificent). Three times.
items.translit: Subhana rabbiyal-Azim. [Three times.]

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
items.tr: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah, our Lord. O Allah, forgive me.
items.translit: Subhanakallahumma rabbana wa bihamdik, Allahummaghfir li.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
items.tr: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah, our Lord. O Allah, forgive me.
items.translit: Subhanakallahumma rabbana wa bihamdik, Allahummaghfir li.

items.ar: ((سُبُّوُحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ)).
items.tr: Supremely Glorified, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
items.translit: Subbuhun Quddusun rabbul-malaikati war-ruh.

items.ar: ((سُبوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ)).
items.tr: Supremely Glorified, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
items.translit: Subbuhun Quddusun rabbul-malaikati war-ruh.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي، وَبَصَرِي، وَمُخِّي، وَعَــــظْمِي، وَعَصَبِي، [وَمَا استَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِي])).
items.tr: O Allah, to You I bow, in You I believe and to You I submit. My hearing, sight, marrow, bones and sinews humble themselves before You, [as does all that my feet bear].
items.translit: Allahumma laka rakatu wa bika amantu wa laka aslamt, khashaa laka sami wa basari wa mukhkhi wa azmi wa asabi, [wa mastaqallat bihi qadami].

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ)).
items.tr: Glory be to the Possessor of irresistible might, dominion, supreme greatness and majesty.
items.translit: Subhana dhil-jabaruti wal-malakuti wal-kibriyai wal-azamah.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ)).
items.tr: Glory be to the Possessor of irresistible might, dominion, supreme greatness and majesty.
items.translit: Subhana dhil-jabaruti wal-malakuti wal-kibriyai wal-azamah.

items.ar: ((سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ)).
items.tr: Allah hears whoever praises Him.
items.translit: Samiallahu liman hamidah.

items.ar: ((رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْداً كَثيراً طَيِّباً مُبارَكاً فِيهِ)).
items.tr: Our Lord, all praise belongs to You: abundant, good and blessed praise.
items.translit: Rabbana wa lakal-hamd, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih.

items.ar: ((مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيءٍ بَعْدُ. أَهلَ الثَّناءِ وَالْمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ)).
items.tr: Filling the heavens, the earth, what lies between them, and whatever else You will. Possessor of praise and glory: the truest words a servant can say, and we are all Your servants. O Allah, none can withhold what You give or give what You withhold. No person's worldly fortune can avail him against You.
items.translit: Milas-samawati wa milal-ardi wa ma baynahuma wa mila ma shita min shayin bad. Ahlath-thanai wal-majd, ahaqqu ma qalal-abdu wa kulluna laka abd. Allahumma la mania lima atayta wa la mutiya lima manat, wa la yanfau dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى)) ثلاث مرَّاتٍ.
items.tr: Glory be to my Lord, Al-Ala (the Most High). Three times.
items.translit: Subhana rabbiyal-Ala. [Three times.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسنُ الْخَالِقينَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, to You I prostrate, in You I believe and to You I submit. My face prostrates to the One who created and fashioned it and opened its hearing and sight. Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
items.translit: Allahumma laka sajadtu wa bika amantu wa laka aslamt. Sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu wa sawwarahu wa shaqqa samahu wa basarah, tabarakallahu ahsanul-khaliqin.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ: دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلاَنِيَّتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ)).
items.tr: O Allah, forgive all my sins: small and great, first and last, public and secret.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullahu, diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa akhirah, wa alaniyatahu wa sirrah.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, in Your pardon from Your punishment, and in You from You. I cannot enumerate praise of You. You are as You have praised Yourself.
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu biridaka min sakhatik, wa bimuafatika min uqubatik, wa audhu bika mink, la uhsi thanaan alayk, anta kama athnayta ala nafsik.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُــــوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, in Your pardon from Your punishment, and in You from You. I cannot enumerate praise of You. You are as You have praised Yourself.
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu biridaka min sakhatik, wa bimuafatika min uqubatik, wa audhu bika mink, la uhsi thanaan alayk, anta kama athnayta ala nafsik.

items.ar: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي)).
items.tr: My Lord, forgive me; my Lord, forgive me.
items.translit: Rabbighfir li, rabbighfir li.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي)).
items.tr: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, mend my condition, grant me well-being, provide for me and raise me.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir li warhamni wahdini wajburni wa afini warzuqni warfani.

items.ar: ((سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، ﴿فَتَبارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ﴾)).
items.tr:
My face has prostrated to the One Who created it and opened its hearing and sight by His might and power. فَتَبارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ [Full-verse context (23:14):
Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.[950]
[950] i.e., the most skillful and only true Creator.].

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْراً، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْراً، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْراً، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, record for me a reward with You through this prostration, remove a burden from me through it, make it a treasure for me with You, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your servant Dawud.
items.translit: Allahummaktub li biha indaka ajran, wa da anni biha wizran, waj alha li indaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalha minni kama taqabbaltaha min abdika Dawud.

items.ar: ((التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَواتُ، وَالطَّيِّباتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسولُهُ)).
items.tr: All greetings of reverence, prayers and good things belong to Allah. Peace be upon you, Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and Allah's righteous servants. I bear witness that none is worthy of worship except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
items.translit: At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat, as-salamu alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, as-salamu alayna wa ala ibadillahis-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ)).
items.tr: O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's family as You blessed Ibrahim and Ibrahim's family. You are Hamid (Praiseworthy), Majid (Glorious). O Allah, bestow blessing upon Muhammad and Muhammad's family as You bestowed blessing upon Ibrahim and Ibrahim's family. You are Hamid, Majid.
items.translit: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْواجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ)).
items.tr: O Allah, bless Muhammad, his wives and descendants as You blessed Ibrahim's family. Bestow blessing upon Muhammad, his wives and descendants as You bestowed blessing upon Ibrahim's family. You are Hamid (Praiseworthy), Majid (Glorious).
items.translit: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatih, kama sallayta ala ali Ibrahim. Wa barik ala Muhammadin wa ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatih, kama barakta ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُــمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, the punishment of Jahannam (Hell), the trials of life and death, and the evil of the trial of Al-Masih ad-Dajjal (the false messiah).
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu bika min adhabil-qabr, wa min adhabi Jahannam, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the trial of Al-Masih ad-Dajjal (the false messiah), and from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and debt.
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu bika min adhabil-qabr, wa audhu bika min fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal, wa audhu bika min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat. Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-mathami wal-maghram.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْماً كَثِيراً، وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins except You. Grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me. You are Al-Ghafur (the All-Forgiving), Ar-Rahim (the Especially Merciful).
items.translit: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min indik warhamni, innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, forgive what I have done before and what I do later, what I conceal and what I disclose, my excesses, and what You know better than I. You are Al-Muqaddim (the One who brings forward), Al-Muakhkhir (the One who puts back); none is worthy of worship except You.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma alantu wa ma asraftu wa ma anta alamu bihi minni. Antal-Muqaddimu wa antal-Muakhkhiru la ilaha illa ant.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبادَتِكَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You and worship You well.
items.translit: Allahumma ainni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, cowardice, being returned to the most feeble old age, the trials of this world and the punishment of the grave.
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-bukhl, wa audhu bika minal-jubn, wa audhu bika min an uradda ila ardhalil-umur, wa audhu bika min fitnatid-dunya wa adhabil-qabr.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.translit: Allahumma inni asalukal-jannata wa audhu bika minan-nar.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيماً لاَ يَنْفَدُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَأَسْــــأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقائِكَ فِي غَيرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، وَلاَ فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive while You know life is better for me, and cause me to die when You know death is better for me. O Allah, I ask You for fear of You in private and public, truthful words in contentment and anger, moderation in wealth and poverty, bliss that never ends, delight that never ceases, contentment after Your decree, the coolness of life after death, the joy of looking upon Your Face and longing to meet You, without harmful adversity or misleading trial. O Allah, adorn us with the beauty of iman (faith) and make us rightly guided guides.
items.translit: Allahumma bi-ilmikal-ghayba wa qudratika alal-khalqi ahyini ma alimtal-hayata khayran li wa tawaffani idha alimtal-wafata khayran li. Allahumma inni asaluka khash yataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahadah, wa asaluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-rida wal-ghadab, wa asalukal-qasda fil-ghina wal-faqr, wa asaluka naiman la yanfad, wa asaluka qurrata aynin la tanqati, wa asalukar-rida badal-qada, wa asaluka bardal-ayshi badal-mawt, wa asaluka ladhdhatan-nazari ila wajhik, wash-shawqa ila liqaika fi ghayri darraa mudirratin wa la fitnatin mudillah. Allahumma zayyinna bizinatil-iman, waj alna hudatan muhtadin.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا أَللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِّيمُ)).
items.tr:
O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by Your being Al-Wahid (the One), Al-Ahad (the Unique), As-Samad (the One on Whom all depend), Who لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ [Full-verse context (112:3):
He neither begets nor is born,

Full-verse context (112:4):
Nor is there to Him any equivalent."], to forgive my sins. You are Al-Ghafur (the Oft-Forgiving), Ar-Rahim (the Most Merciful).
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka ya Allahu bi-annakal-Wahidul-Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad, an taghfira li dhunubi innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، الْمَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I ask You because all praise belongs to You. None is worthy of worship except You alone, without partner, Al-Mannan (the Bestower of favors). Originator of the heavens and earth, Possessor of majesty and honor, Ya Hayy (Ever-Living), Ya Qayyum (Sustainer of all), I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka bi-anna lakal-hamda la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika lak, al-Mannan, ya Badias-samawati wal-ard, ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram, ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, inni asalukal-jannata wa audhu bika minan-nar.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ)) .
items.tr:
O Allah, I ask You by my testimony that You are Allah; none deserves worship except You, Al-Ahad (the Unique), As-Samad (the One on Whom all depend), Who لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ [Full-verse context (112:3):
He neither begets nor is born,

Full-verse context (112:4):
Nor is there to Him any equivalent."].
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka bi-anni ashhadu annaka antallahu la ilaha illa antal-Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.

items.ar: ((أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلاَثَاً) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ)).
items.tr: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are As-Salam (the One free of imperfection), and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of majesty and honor.
items.translit: Astaghfirullah [three times]. Allahumma antas-Salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram.

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ [ثلاثاً]، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ)).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things [three times]. O Allah, none can withhold what You give or give what You withhold. No person's worldly fortune can avail him against You.
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir [three times]. Allahumma la mania lima atayta wa la mutiya lima manat, wa la yanfau dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.

items.ar: ((لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ, لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ)).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. There is no power or strength except through Allah. None is worthy of worship except Allah; we worship none but Him. His are blessing, bounty and good praise. None is worthy of worship except Allah; we devote religion sincerely to Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir. La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illallah, wa la nabudu illa iyyah, lahun-nimatu wa lahul-fadlu wa lahuth-thanaul-hasan, la ilaha illallahu mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
items.tr: Glory be to Allah; all praise belongs to Allah; Allah is greatest (thirty-three times each). None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.
items.translit: Subhanallah, walhamdu lillah, wallahu akbar [thirty-three times each]. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir.

items.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾،بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ بَعْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
items.tr:
In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ [Full-verse context (112:1):
Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,[2011]
[2011] Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.

Full-verse context (112:2):
Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.[2012]
[2012] He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.

Full-verse context (112:3):
He neither begets nor is born,

Full-verse context (112:4):
Nor is there to Him any equivalent."]. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ [Full-verse context (113:1):
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

Full-verse context (113:2):
From the evil of that which He created

Full-verse context (113:3):
And from the evil of darkness when it settles

Full-verse context (113:4):
And from the evil of the blowers in knots[2014]
[2014] i.e., those who practice magic.

Full-verse context (113:5):
And from the evil of an envier when he envies."]. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ [Full-verse context (114:1):
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:2):
The Sovereign of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:3):
The God of mankind,

Full-verse context (114:4):
From the evil of the retreating whisperer[2016] -
[2016] i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.

Full-verse context (114:5):
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

Full-verse context (114:6):
From among the jinn and mankind."[2017]
[2017] Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.]. After every salah (prayer).

items.ar: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾ عَقِبَ كلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
items.tr:
اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ [Full-verse context (2:255):
Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living,[98] the Self-Sustaining.[99] Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[100] and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī[101] extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High,[102] the Most Great.[103]
[98] Whose life is perfect, complete and eternal, without beginning or end, and through whom all created life originated and continues.
[99] Dependent on none for His existence while being the sustainer and administrator of all created existence.
[100] Allāh's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.
[101] Chair or footstool. It is not to be confused with al-ʿArsh (the Throne) , which is infinitely higher and greater than al-Kursī.
[102] Above all of His creations and superior to them in essence, rank and position.
[103] Whose greatness is unlimited, beyond description or imagination.]. Following every salah (prayer).

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)) عَشْرَ مَرّاتٍ بَعْدَ صَلاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالصُّبْحِ.
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things. Ten times after Maghrib and Fajr prayers.
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir. [Ten times after Maghrib and Fajr.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً)) بَعْدَ السّلامِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الفَجْرِ.
items.tr: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision and accepted deeds. After the closing salam (greeting of peace) of Fajr prayer.
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka ilman nafian wa rizqan tayyiban wa amalan mutaqabbala. [After Fajr prayer.]

items.ar: قَالَ جَابرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: كَانَ رسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُنَا الْاسْتِخَارَةَ فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، يَقُولُ: ((إِذَا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِالْأَمْرِ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الْفَرِيضَةِ، ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأمْرَ - وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ - خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أَوْ قَالَ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ - فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أَوْ قَالَ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ – فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ)).وَمَا نَدِمَ مَنِ اسْتَخَارَ الْخَالِقَ، وَشَاوَرَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَتَثَبَّتَ فِي أَمْرِهِ، فَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّه تعالى: ﴿وَشاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ .
items.tr:
Jabir ibn Abd Allah, may Allah be pleased with them both, said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, used to teach us istikharah (seeking Allah's choice) in all matters as he taught us a surah of the Quran, saying: 'When any of you intends to undertake a matter, let him pray two rakahs (units of prayer) other than the obligatory prayer, then say: O Allah, I seek Your choice through Your knowledge, and I seek ability through Your power, and I ask You of Your immense bounty. You are able and I am not; You know and I do not; You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter' — and he names his need — 'is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affair' — or he said: 'in its immediate and later consequences' — 'then decree it for me, make it easy for me, then bless it for me. If You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affair' — or he said: 'in its immediate and later consequences' — 'then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree good for me wherever it may be, then make me content with it.' Whoever seeks the Creator's choice, consults believing people and carefully considers his affair does not regret it. Allah Most High said: وَشاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ [Full-verse context (3:159):
So by mercy from Allāh, [O Muḥammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allāh. Indeed, Allāh loves those who rely [upon Him].].

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ)).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah, Al-Wahid (the One), Al-Qahhar (the Subduer), Lord of the heavens, earth and what lies between them, Al-Aziz (the Almighty), Al-Ghaffar (the Oft-Forgiving).
items.translit: La ilaha illallahul-Wahidul-Qahhar, rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahumal-Azizul-Ghaffar.

items.ar: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ)).
items.tr: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His servants, from the incitements of devils and from their presence.
items.translit: Audhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa iqabihi wa sharri ibadih, wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdurun.

items.ar: [ (يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ (ثلاثاً)) - (يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى (ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ)) - ((لاَ يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا أَحَداً)) - ((يَــتَحَوَّلُ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ)) ]
items.tr: Blow lightly to your left three times. Seek refuge in Allah from Satan and the evil of what you saw three times. Do not tell anyone about it. Turn from the side you were lying on.

items.ar: ((ويَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ)).
items.tr: Get up and pray if you wish.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، [وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنا وَتَعَالَيْتَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless what You have given me, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. You decree, and none decrees over You. Whoever You befriend is not humiliated, [and whoever You oppose is not honored]. Blessed and exalted are You, our Lord.
items.translit: Allahummahdini fiman hadayt, wa afini fiman afayt, wa tawallani fiman tawallayt, wa barik li fima atayt, wa qini sharra ma qadayt, fa innaka taqdi wa la yuqda alayk, innahu la yadhillu man walayt, [wa la yaizzu man adayt], tabarakta rabbana wa taalayt.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, You alone we worship; to You we pray and prostrate; toward You we strive and hasten. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment; Your punishment will overtake the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your help and forgiveness, praise You with good, do not deny You, believe in You, submit to You and disown whoever disbelieves in You.
items.translit: Allahumma iyyaka nabudu wa laka nusalli wa nasjud, wa ilayka nasa wa nahfid, narju rahmataka wa nakhsha adhabak, inna adhabaka bil-kafirina mulhaq. Allahumma inna nastainuka wa nastaghfiruka wa nuthni alaykal-khayra wa la nakfuruk, wa numinu bika wa nakhdau lak, wa nakhlau man yakfuruk.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ)) ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ والثَّالِثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بها ويَمُدُّ بها صَوتَهُ يقولُ: [رَبِّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ])).
items.tr: Glory be to Al-Malik (the King), Al-Quddus (the Most Holy). Three times, raising and prolonging the voice on the third, saying: [Lord of the angels and the Spirit].
items.translit: Subhanal-Malikil-Quddus. [Three times, louder and prolonged on the third:] [Rabbil-malaikati war-ruh.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُــــلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي)).
items.tr: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your male servant and Your female servant. My forelock is in Your hand; Your judgment concerning me takes effect, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You, with which You named Yourself, revealed in Your Book, taught any of Your creation, or kept with Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen, to make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the clearing of my sadness and the departure of my worry.
items.translit: Allahumma inni abduka ibnu abdika ibnu amatik, nasiyati biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, adlun fiyya qadauk, asaluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fi kitabik, aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqik, awistatharta bihi fi ilmil-ghaybi indak, an tajalal-Qurana rabia qalbi wa nura sadri wa jalaa huzni wa dhahaba hammi.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and sadness, incapacity and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dalaid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and sadness, incapacity and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dalaid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ)).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah, Al-Azim (the Magnificent), Al-Halim (the Forbearing). None is worthy of worship except Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. None is worthy of worship except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the noble Throne.
items.translit: La ilaha illallahul-Azimul-Halim, la ilaha illallahu rabbul-arshil-azim, la ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardi wa rabbul-arshil-karim.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Set all my affairs right. None is worthy of worship except You.
items.translit: Allahumma rahmataka arju, fa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn, wa aslih li shani kullah, la ilaha illa ant.

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ)).
items.tr:
Full-verse context (21:87):
And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger[899] and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him.[900] And he called out within the darknesses,[901] "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
[899] At the disbelief of his people.
[900] Or "would not restrict him" in the belly of the fish.
[901] That of the night, of the sea, and of the fish's interior.
items.translit: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً)).
items.tr: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I associate nothing with Him.
items.translit: Allahu Allahu rabbi la ushriku bihi shaya.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ)).
items.tr: O Allah, we place You before them and seek refuge in You from their evils.
items.translit: Allahumma inna najaluka fi nuhurihim wa naudhu bika min shururihim.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ)).
items.tr: O Allah, You are my support and my helper. Through You I maneuver, through You I attack, and through You I fight.
items.translit: Allahumma anta adudi wa anta nasiri, bika ahulu wa bika asulu wa bika uqatil.

items.ar: ((حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ)).
items.tr:
Full-verse context (3:173):
Those to whom people [i.e., hypocrites] said, "Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." But it [merely] increased them in faith, and they said, "Sufficient for us is Allāh, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs."[150]
[150] The one entrusted and relied upon; sufficient to manage all matters.
items.translit: Hasbunallahu wa nimal-wakil.
