items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the mighty Throne, protect me from so-and-so, son of so-and-so, and his allies among Your creatures, lest any of them act hastily against me or transgress. Mighty is Your protection, exalted is Your praise, and none is worthy of worship except You.
items.translit: Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabi wa rabbal-arshil-azim, kun li jaran min fulanibni fulanin wa ahzabihi min khalaiqik, an yafruta alayya ahadun minhum aw yatgha, azza jaruka wa jalla thanauk, wa la ilaha illa ant.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tr: Allah is greatest. Allah is mightier than all His creation, mightier than what I fear and beware of. I seek refuge in Allah, none is worthy of worship except Him, who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His permission, from the evil of Your servant so-and-so, his soldiers, followers and supporters among jinn (unseen beings) and humans. O Allah, protect me from their evil. Exalted is Your praise, mighty is Your protection, blessed is Your name, and none is worthy of worship besides You. (Three times.)
items.translit: Allahu akbar, Allahu a azzu min khalqihi jamian, Allahu a azzu mimma akhafu wa ahdhar. Audhu billahil-ladhi la ilaha illa huw, al-mumsikis-samawatis-sabi an yaqana alal-ardi illa bi-idhnih, min sharri abdika fulanin wa junudihi wa atbaihi wa ashyaihi minal-jinni wal-ins. Allahumma kun li jaran min sharrihim, jalla thanauka wa azza jaruk, wa tabarakasmuka wa la ilaha ghayruk. [Three times.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ)).
items.tr: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
items.translit: Allahumma munzilal-kitabi sarial-hisab, ihzimil-ahzab, Allahumma hzimhum wa zalzilhum.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, suffice me against them however You will.
items.translit: Allahummakfinihim bima shit.

items.ar: ((يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ و يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ)).
items.tr: Seek refuge in Allah and stop pursuing the matter about which doubt arose.

items.ar: ((يَقُولُ: ((آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ)).
items.tr: Say: I believe in Allah and His messengers.
items.translit: Amantu billahi wa rusulih.

items.ar: ((يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾)).
items.tr:
He recites His statement, Most High: هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ [Full-verse context (57:3):
He is the First[1623] and the Last,[1624] the Ascendant[1625] and the Intimate,[1626] and He is, of all things, Knowing.
[1623] Before whom nothing existed. Also, He who is supreme, foremost or uppermost.
[1624] Enduring eternally when nothing else remains.
[1625] Nothing being above Him. Another meaning is "the Apparent," i.e., evident through His creation and revelation.
[1626] Nothing being nearer than Him by way of His knowledge. Another meaning is "the Unapparent," i.e., concealed from man's physical senses.].

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made halal (lawful) instead of what You have made haram (unlawful), and through Your bounty make me independent of everyone besides You.
items.translit: Allahummakfini bihalalika an haramik, wa aghnini bifadlika amman siwak.

items.ar: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً))).
items.tr: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the accursed. Spit lightly to your left three times.
items.translit: Audhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim. [Spit lightly to your left three times.]

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً)).
items.tr: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make difficulty easy if You will.
items.translit: Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaaltahu sahlan, wa anta tajalul-hazna idha shita sahla.

items.ar: ((مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ)).
items.tr: No servant commits a sin, then purifies himself well, rises and prays two rakahs (units of prayer), and seeks Allah's forgiveness, without Allah forgiving him.

items.ar: ((الْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ)).
items.tr: Seeking refuge in Allah from him.

items.ar: ((الْأَذَانُ)).
items.tr: The adhan (call to prayer).

items.ar: ((الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ)).
items.tr: Adhkar (remembrances) and recitation of the Quran.

items.ar: ((قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ)).
items.tr: Allah has decreed, and He does whatever He wills.
items.translit: Qadarullahi wa ma shaa faal.

items.ar: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ)). وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَــــــنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ)).
items.tr: May Allah bless the child granted to you; may you thank the Giver; may the child reach maturity, and may you be granted the child's dutifulness. The parent responds: May Allah bless you and bestow blessings upon you; may Allah reward you with good, grant you the same and give you abundant reward.
items.translit: Barakallahu laka fil-mawhubi lak, wa shakarta al-Wahib, wa balagha ashuddah, wa ruziqta birrah. [Response:] Barakallahu laka wa baraka alayk, wa jazakallahu khayran, wa razaqakallahu mithlah, wa ajzala thawabak.

items.ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ وَالحُسَينَ رضي الله عنهما ((أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ)).
items.tr: Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, used to seek protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, may Allah be pleased with them: 'I seek protection for you both in Allah's perfect words from every devil, poisonous creature and harmful evil eye.'
items.translit: Uidhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli aynin lammah.

items.ar: ((لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
items.tr: No harm; a purification, if Allah wills.
items.translit: La basa tahurun in sha Allah.

items.ar: ((أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ)) (سبع مرات).
items.tr: I ask Allah, Al-Azim (the Magnificent), Lord of the mighty Throne, to heal you. (Seven times.)
items.translit: Asalullahal-Azima rabbal-arshil-azimi an yashfiyak. [Seven times.]

items.ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ)).
items.tr: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: When a man visits his Muslim brother who is ill, he walks among the fruits of Paradise until he sits. When he sits, mercy envelops him. If it is morning, seventy thousand angels invoke blessings upon him until evening; if it is evening, seventy thousand angels invoke blessings upon him until morning.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى)).
items.tr: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me and join me with the highest company.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir li warhamni wa alhiqni bir-rafiqil-ala.

items.ar: ((جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ، وَيَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ)).
items.tr: As he was dying, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, dipped his hands into water, wiped his face with them and said: None is worthy of worship except Allah; death indeed has agonies.

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah, and Allah is greatest. None is worthy of worship except Allah alone. None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. None is worthy of worship except Allah; His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. None is worthy of worship except Allah; there is no power or strength except through Allah.
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, la ilaha illallahu wahdah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, la ilaha illallahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, la ilaha illallahu wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

items.ar: ((مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ)).
items.tr: Whoever's final words are 'None is worthy of worship except Allah' will enter Paradise.

items.ar: ((إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا)).
items.tr:
إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ [Full-verse context (2:156):
Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return."]. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
items.translit: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi rajiun, Allahumma jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلاَنٍ (بِاسْمِهِ) وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ  يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, forgive so-and-so (mention the name), raise his rank among the guided, and take care of his descendants who remain behind. Forgive us and him, Lord of the worlds. Make his grave spacious and illuminate it for him.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir li-fulan [name], warfa darajatahu fil-mahdiyyin, wakhlufhu fi aqibihi fil-ghabirin, waghfir lana wa lahu ya rabbal-alamin, wafsah lahu fi qabrihi wa nawwir lahu fih.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ])).
items.tr: O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him. Honor his reception, widen his entrance, wash him with water, snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as You cleanse a white garment of dirt. Replace his home with a better home, his family with a better family and his spouse with a better spouse. Admit him to Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and the punishment of the Fire].
items.translit: Allahummaghfir lahu warhamhu wa afihi wafu anh, wa akrim nuzulahu wa wassi mudkhalah, waghsilhu bil-mai wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa ahlan khayran min ahlih, wa zawjan khayran min zawjih, wa adkhilhul-jannata wa aidhhu min adhabil-qabr [wa adhabin-nar].

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ)).
items.tr: O Allah, forgive our living and dead, those present and absent, our young and old, our males and females. O Allah, whoever among us You keep alive, keep him upon Islam, and whoever among us You take in death, take him upon iman (faith). O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward or lead us astray after him.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir lihayyina wa mayyitina wa shahidina wa ghaibina wa saghirina wa kabirina wa dhakarina wa unthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa ahyihi alal-Islam, wa man tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu alal-iman. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu wa la tudillana badah.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ)).
items.tr: O Allah, so-and-so, son of so-and-so, is under Your covenant and protection. Protect him from the trial of the grave and punishment of the Fire. You are worthy of faithfulness and truth, so forgive him and have mercy on him. You are Al-Ghafur (the All-Forgiving), Ar-Rahim (the Especially Merciful).
items.translit: Allahumma inna fulanabna fulanin fi dhimmatika wa habli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabri wa adhabin-nar, wa anta ahlul-wafai wal-haqq, faghfir lahu warhamhu innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ)).
items.tr: O Allah, Your servant, the son of Your female servant, needs Your mercy, while You have no need to punish him. If he did good, increase his good deeds; if he did wrong, pardon him.
items.translit: Allahumma abduka wabnu amatikahtaja ila rahmatik, wa anta ghaniyyun an adhabih. In kana muhsinan fazid fi hasanatih, wa in kana musian fatajawaz anh.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ)) وإن قال: ((اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ)) إن قال ذلك فَحَسَنٌ.
items.tr: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave. It is also good to say: O Allah, make him a forerunner and treasure for his parents and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and magnify their rewards through him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him in Ibrahim's care and, by Your mercy, protect him from the punishment of the blazing Fire. Replace his home with a better home and his family with a better family. O Allah, forgive our predecessors, our children who died before us, and those who preceded us in faith.
items.translit: Allahumma aidhhu min adhabil-qabr. [It is also good to say:] Allahummaj alhu faratan wa dhukhran liwalidayh, wa shafian mujaba. Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazinahuma wa azim bihi ujurahuma, wa alhiqhu bisalihil-muminin, waj alhu fi kafalati Ibrahim, wa qihi birahmatika adhabal-jahim, wa abdilhu daran khayran min darihi wa ahlan khayran min ahlih. Allahummaghfir li-aslafina wa afratina wa man sabaqana bil-iman.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً)).
items.tr: O Allah, make him for us a forerunner, a predecessor and a reward.
items.translit: Allahummaj alhu lana faratan wa salafan wa ajra.

items.ar: ((إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ)). وَإِنْ قَالَ: ((أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ)) فَحَسَنٌ.
items.tr: To Allah belongs what He takes and what He gives; everything with Him has an appointed term … so be patient and seek reward. It is also good to say: May Allah magnify your reward, grant you good consolation and forgive your deceased.
items.translit: Inna lillahi ma akhadha wa lahu ma ata wa kullu shayin indahu bi-ajalin musamman ... faltasbir waltahtasib. [It is also good to say:] Azamallahu ajraka wa ahsana azaaka wa ghafara limayyitik.

items.ar: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ)).
items.tr: In Allah's name and upon the Sunnah (way) of Allah's Messenger.
items.translit: Bismillahi wa ala sunnati rasulillah.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ)).
items.tr: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, make him steadfast.
items.translit: Allahummaghfir lah, Allahumma thabbithu.

items.ar: ((السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ)).
items.tr: Peace be upon you, inhabitants of these dwellings among the believers and Muslims. If Allah wills, we will join you. [May Allah have mercy upon those of us who have gone ahead and those who come later.] I ask Allah for well-being for us and you.
items.translit: As-salamu alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-muminina wal-Muslimin, wa inna in sha Allahu bikum lahiqun. [Wa yarhamullahul-mustaqdimina minna wal-mustakhirin.] Asalullaha lana wa lakumul-afiyah.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْــــــأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا)).
items.tr: O Allah, I ask You for its good and seek refuge in You from its evil.
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka khayraha wa audhu bika min sharriha.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it and the good it was sent with. I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it and the evil it was sent with.
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka khayraha wa khayra ma fiha wa khayra ma ursilat bih, wa audhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ursilat bih.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ)).
items.tr:
Glory be to the One of Whom it is said: يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ [Full-verse context (13:13):
And the thunder exalts [Allāh] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allāh; and He is severe in assault.].
items.translit: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-radu bihamdihi wal-malaikatu min khifatih.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ)).
items.tr: O Allah, give us relieving rain, wholesome and fruitful, beneficial and not harmful, soon rather than delayed.
items.translit: Allahummasqina ghaythan mughithan marian marian, nafian ghayra darrin, ajilan ghayra ajil.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا)).
items.tr: O Allah, send us rain; O Allah, send us rain; O Allah, send us rain.
items.translit: Allahumma aghithna, Allahumma aghithna, Allahumma aghithna.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, give water to Your servants and animals, spread Your mercy and revive Your dead land.
items.translit: Allahummasqi ibadaka wa baha imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa ahyi baladakal-mayyit.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً)).
items.tr: O Allah, make it beneficial rain.
items.translit: Allahumma sayyiban nafia.

items.ar: ((مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ)).
items.tr: We have been given rain through Allah's bounty and mercy.
items.translit: Mutirna bifadlillahi wa rahmatih.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ)).
items.tr: O Allah, around us, not upon us. O Allah, upon the hills, mounds, valley beds and places where trees grow.
items.translit: Allahumma hawalayna wa la alayna. Allahumma alal-akami waz-zirabi wa butunil-awdiyati wa manabitish-shajar.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ)).
items.tr: Allah is greatest. O Allah, bring this crescent upon us with security, iman (faith), safety, Islam, and success in what You love and approve of, our Lord. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
items.translit: Allahu akbar. Allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, wat-tawfiqi lima tuhibbu rabbana wa tarda, rabbuna wa rabbukallah.

items.ar: ((ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
items.tr: Thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is assured, if Allah wills.
items.translit: Dhahabaz-zamau wabtallatil-uruqu wa thabatal-ajru in sha Allah.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي)).
items.tr: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses everything, to forgive me.
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka birahmatikal-lati wasiat kulla shayin an taghfira li.

items.ar: ((إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ)).
items.tr: When one of you eats, let him say 'In Allah's name.' If he forgets at the beginning, let him say: 'In Allah's name at its beginning and end.'
items.translit: Bismillah. [If forgotten at the beginning:] Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirih.

items.ar: ((مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ)).
items.tr: Whoever Allah gives food should say: 'O Allah, bless it for us and feed us something better than it.' Whoever Allah gives milk should say: 'O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.'
items.translit: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa atimna khayran minh. [For milk:] Allahumma barik lana fihi wa zidna minh.

items.ar: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ)).
items.tr: All praise belongs to Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me without power or strength on my part.
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi atamani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.

items.ar: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا)).
items.tr: All praise belongs to Allah: abundant, good and blessed praise. Our Lord needs none, is not forsaken and cannot be dispensed with.
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih, ghayra [makfiyyin wa la] muwaddain wa la mustaghnan anhu rabbana.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ)).
items.tr: O Allah, bless what You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy on them.
items.translit: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي)).
items.tr: O Allah, feed whoever fed me, and give drink to whoever gave me drink.
items.translit: Allahumma atim man atamani wasqi man saqani.

items.ar: ((أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ)).
items.tr: May fasting people break their fast with you, righteous people eat your food, and angels invoke blessings upon you.
items.translit: Aftara indakumus-saimun, wa akala taamakumul-abrar, wa sallat alaykumul-malaikah.

items.ar: ((إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ)) ، وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ.
items.tr: When one of you is invited, let him respond. If fasting, let him supplicate; if not fasting, let him eat. The meaning of 'let him pray' here is 'let him supplicate.'

items.ar: ((إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ)).
items.tr: I am fasting; I am fasting.
items.translit: Inni saim, inni saim.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا)).
items.tr: O Allah, bless our fruit, bless our city, bless our sa (measure of volume), and bless our mudd (measure of volume).
items.translit: Allahumma barik lana fi thamarina, wa barik lana fi madinatina, wa barik lana fi saina, wa barik lana fi muddina.

items.ar: ((إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
items.tr: When one of you sneezes, let him say: 'All praise belongs to Allah.' His brother or companion should say: 'May Allah have mercy on you.' When he says that to him, let him respond: 'May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.'
items.translit: Alhamdu lillah. [Response:] Yarhamukallah. [Reply:] Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.

items.ar: ((يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
items.tr: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.
items.translit: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.

items.ar: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ)).
items.tr: May Allah bless you, bestow blessings upon you and unite you both in good.
items.translit: Barakallahu laka wa baraka alayka wa jamaa baynakuma fi khayr.

items.ar: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ)).
items.tr: When one of you marries a woman or buys a servant, let him say: 'O Allah, I ask You for her good and the good of the nature You gave her, and seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of the nature You gave her.' When buying a camel, let him take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.
items.translit: Allahumma inni asaluka khayraha wa khayra ma jabaltaha alayh, wa audhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma jabaltaha alayh. [When buying a camel, take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.]

items.ar: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا)).
items.tr: In Allah's name. O Allah, keep Satan away from us, and keep Satan away from what You provide us.
items.translit: Bismillah. Allahumma jannibnash-shaytana wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.

items.ar: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)).
items.tr: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the accursed.
items.translit: Audhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.

items.ar: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً)).
items.tr: All praise belongs to Allah, who spared me what He afflicted you with and favored me greatly over many whom He created.
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi afani mimmabtalaka bihi wa faddalani ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdila.

items.ar: ((عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ)).
items.tr: Ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, said: In a single gathering before he rose, Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, was counted saying one hundred times: 'My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. You are At-Tawwab (the One who accepts repentance), Al-Ghafur (the All-Forgiving).'
items.translit: Rabbighfir li wa tub alayya innaka antat-Tawwabul-Ghafur.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ)).
items.tr: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. I bear witness that none is worthy of worship except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
items.translit: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.

items.tr: And for you too.
items.translit: Wa lak.

items.ar: ((جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً)).
items.tr: May Allah reward you with good.
items.translit: Jazakallahu khayra.

items.ar: ((مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ)) ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
items.tr: Whoever memorizes ten ayat (verses) from the beginning of Surah Al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal (false messiah). Also seek refuge in Allah from his trial after the final tashahhud (seated testimony) of every salah (prayer).

items.ar: ((أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ)).
items.tr: May the One for whose sake you loved me love you.
items.translit: Ahabbakal-ladhi ahbabtani lah.

items.ar: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ)).
items.tr: May Allah bless your family and wealth.
items.translit: Barakallahu laka fi ahlika wa malik.

items.ar: ((بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ)).
items.tr: May Allah bless your family and wealth. The recompense for a loan is only thanks and repayment.
items.translit: Barakallahu laka fi ahlika wa malik, innama jaza us-salafil-hamdu wal-ada.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ)).
items.tr: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.
items.translit: Allahumma inni audhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana alam, wa astaghfiruka lima la alam.

items.ar: ((وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ)).
items.tr: And may Allah bless you too.
items.translit: Wa fika barakallah.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)).
items.tr: O Allah, no omen exists except what You decree, no good exists except Your good, and none is worthy of worship besides You.
items.translit: Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wa la khayra illa khayruk, wa la ilaha ghayruk.

items.ar: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾، ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
items.tr:
In the name of Allah, and praise belongs to Allah. سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ [Full-verse context (43:13):
That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.[1433]
[1433] Literally, "made it a companion" or "made it compatible."

Full-verse context (43:14):
And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."]. Praise belongs to Allah. Praise belongs to Allah. Praise belongs to Allah. Allah is greatest. Allah is greatest. Allah is greatest. Glory be to You, O Allah. I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for no one forgives sins except You.

items.ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَليفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ))، وإذا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ: ((آيِبُونَ، تائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ)).
items.tr:
Allah is greatest. Allah is greatest. Allah is greatest. سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ [Full-verse context (43:13):
That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.[1433]
[1433] Literally, "made it a companion" or "made it compatible."

Full-verse context (43:14):
And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."]. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and taqwa (mindfulness of You) on this journey of ours, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey of ours easy for us and shorten its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One Who looks after the family in our absence. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, distressing sights, and returning to misfortune in property and family. On returning, he says these words and adds: We return, repenting, worshipping and praising our Lord.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّياطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا)).
items.tr: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they shade, Lord of the seven earths and what they carry, Lord of the devils and those they mislead, and Lord of the winds and what they scatter, I ask You for the good of this town, its people and what is within it. I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people and the evil within it.
items.translit: Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabi wa ma azlaln, wa rabbal-aradinas-sabi wa ma aqlaln, wa rabbash-shayatini wa ma adlaln, wa rabbar-riyahi wa ma dharayn, asaluka khayra hadhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahliha wa khayra ma fiha, wa audhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ahliha wa sharri ma fiha.

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاِ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and never dies. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa Hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayru wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir.

items.tr: In Allah's name.
items.translit: Bismillah.

items.ar: ((أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ)).
items.tr: I entrust you to Allah, whose trusts are never lost.
items.translit: Astawdiukumullahal-ladhi la tadiu wadaiuh.

items.ar: (( أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ)).
items.tr: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust and the endings of your deeds.
items.translit: Astawdiullaha dinaka wa amanataka wa khawatima amalik.

items.ar: ((زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ ما كُنْتَ)).
items.tr: May Allah provide you with taqwa (God-consciousness), forgive your sin and make good easy for you wherever you are.
items.translit: Zawwadakallahu at-taqwa wa ghafara dhanbaka wa yassara lakal-khayra haythu ma kunt.

items.ar: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رضي الله عنه: ((كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا)).
items.tr: Jabir, may Allah be pleased with him, said: When we ascended, we said takbir (Allah is greatest), and when we descended, we glorified Allah.

items.ar: ((سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذاً بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
items.tr: May a listener hear our praise of Allah and His good favor upon us. Our Lord, accompany us and bestow Your bounty upon us. I seek refuge in Allah from the Fire.
items.translit: Sammaa samiun bihamdillahi wa husni balaihi alayna, rabbana sahibna wa afdil alayna, aidhan billahi minan-nar.

items.ar: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)).
items.tr: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He created.
items.translit: Audhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.

items.ar: ((يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ)).
items.tr: Say takbir (Allah is greatest) three times on every rise, then say: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. We return, repenting, worshiping and praising our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, supported His servant and defeated the confederates alone.
items.translit: [On every rise: Allahu akbar, three times.] La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir. Ayibuna taibuna abiduna lirabbina hamidun. Sadaqallahu wadahu wa nasara abdahu wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.

items.ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ)) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)).
items.tr: When something pleasing came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, he said: 'All praise belongs to Allah, through whose blessing good deeds are completed.' When something displeasing came to him, he said: 'All praise belongs to Allah in every circumstance.'
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi binimatihi tatimmus-salihat. [When displeased:] Alhamdu lillahi ala kulli hal.

items.ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً)).
items.tr: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Whoever invokes one blessing upon me, Allah will bless him ten times because of it.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Do not make my grave a place of recurring celebration. Invoke blessings upon me, for your blessings reach me wherever you are.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned but who does not invoke blessings upon me.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:((إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Allah has angels traveling throughout the earth who convey to me my community's greetings of peace.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Whenever anyone sends me a greeting of peace, Allah returns my soul to me so that I return his greeting.

items.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم، أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ)).
items.tr: Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, said: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I direct you to something which, if you do it, will make you love one another? Spread salam (the greeting of peace) among yourselves.

items.ar: ((ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ)).
items.tr: Whoever combines three things has combined iman (faith): being fair even against oneself, offering salam (the greeting of peace) to everyone, and spending despite having little.

items.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أيُّ الْإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ: ((تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ)).
items.tr: Abdullah ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, reported that a man asked the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him: Which practice of Islam is best? He said: Feed people and give salam (the greeting of peace) to those you know and those you do not know.

items.ar: ((إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ)).
items.tr: When the People of the Book greet you, say: And upon you.

items.ar: ((إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً)).
items.tr: When you hear roosters crow, ask Allah of His bounty, for they have seen an angel. When you hear a donkey bray, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for it has seen a devil.

items.ar: ((إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلاَبِ وَنَهِيقَ الْحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُنَّ؛ فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لاَ تَرَوْنَ)).
items.tr: When you hear dogs barking and donkeys braying at night, seek refuge in Allah from them, for they see what you do not see.

items.ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ)).
items.tr: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: O Allah, whichever believer I have insulted, make that a means of bringing him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.
items.translit: Allahumma fa-ayyuma muminin sababtuhu fajal dhalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyamah.

items.ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُم مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً، أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا)).
items.tr: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: If one of you must praise his companion, let him say: I consider so-and-so to be such, and Allah is his reckoner; I do not declare anyone pure before Allah. I consider him, if he knows that about him, to be such-and-such.

items.ar: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ])).
items.tr: O Allah, do not hold me accountable for what they say. Forgive me for what they do not know, [and make me better than they think].
items.translit: Allahumma la tuakhidhni bima yaqulun, waghfir li ma la yalamun, [waj alni khayran mimma yazunnun].

items.ar: ((لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ)).
items.tr: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am; You have no partner; here I am. All praise and blessing belong to You, and all dominion. You have no partner.
items.translit: Labbaykallahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-nimata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.

items.ar: ((طَافَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ)).
items.tr: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, circled the Kabah on a camel. Whenever he came to the corner, he pointed toward it with something he held and said takbir (Allah is greatest).

items.ar: ((﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ﴾)).
items.tr:
Full-verse context (2:201):
But among them is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."

items.ar: لَمَّا دَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ)) فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذلكَ. قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ)) الْحَدِيثُ. وَفِيهِ: ((فَفَعَلَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا)).
items.tr:
When the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, approached As-Safa, he recited: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ [Full-verse context (2:158):
Indeed, aṣ-Ṣafā and al-Marwah are among the symbols[55] of Allāh. So whoever makes ḥajj [pilgrimage] to the House or performs ʿumrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them.[56] And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allāh is Appreciative[57] and Knowing.
[55] Places designated for the rites of ḥajj and ʿumrah.
[56] Some believers had previously feared that this might be a pagan practice, so Allāh confirms that saʿī is among the rites of His religion.
[57] i.e., He rewards generously.]. 'I begin with what Allah began with.' So he began with As-Safa and climbed it until he saw the House. He faced the qiblah (direction of prayer), proclaimed Allah's oneness and greatness, and said: 'None deserves worship except Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs praise, and He has power over all things. None deserves worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant and defeated the confederates alone.' Then he supplicated between these statements. He said this three times. The hadith also says: 'He did at Al-Marwah as he had done at As-Safa.'

items.ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، وَخَيْرُ مَا قُلْتُ أَنَا وَالنَّبيُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلِي: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
items.tr: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: The best supplication is the supplication on the day of Arafah. The best words I and the prophets before me have said are: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.

items.ar: رَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَللَّهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفاً حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدَّاً فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمسُ.
items.tr: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, rode Al-Qaswa until he reached Al-Mashar al-Haram, faced the qiblah (direction of prayer), supplicated to Allah, declared His greatness, proclaimed that none is worthy of worship except Him, and affirmed His oneness. He remained standing until it was very light, then departed before sunrise.

items.ar: ((يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الْجِمَارِ الثَّلاَثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، ويَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبلَةِ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا)).
items.tr: Say takbir (Allah is greatest) with every pebble thrown at the three jamarat (pillars). After the first and second, move forward and stand supplicating, facing the qiblah (direction of prayer) with raised hands. At Jamrat al-Aqabah, throw the pebbles and say takbir with each one, then leave without standing there.

items.ar: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ!)).
items.tr: Glory be to Allah!
items.translit: Subhanallah!

items.tr: Allah is greatest!
items.translit: Allahu akbar!

items.ar: ((كَانَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى)).
items.tr: When something pleasing happened or good news came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, he fell in prostration out of gratitude to Allah, blessed and exalted is He.

items.ar: ((ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَألَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، ثَلاَثاً، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ)).
items.tr: Place your hand on the painful part of your body and say 'In Allah's name' three times, then say seven times: 'I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear.'
items.translit: Bismillah [three times]. Audhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir [seven times].

items.ar: ((إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُم مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ)).
items.tr: If one of you sees something pleasing in his brother, himself or his wealth, [let him pray for blessing upon it], for the evil eye is real.

items.ar: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ!)).
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah!
items.translit: La ilaha illallah!

items.ar: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي)).
items.tr: In Allah's name, and Allah is greatest. [O Allah, from You and for You.] O Allah, accept it from me.
items.translit: Bismillahi wallahu akbar. [Allahumma minka wa lak.] Allahumma taqabbal minni.

items.ar: ((أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلاَّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ)).
items.tr: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words, beyond which neither a righteous nor wicked person can pass, from the evil of what He created, originated and brought into being; from the evil of what descends from heaven and ascends into it; from the evil of what He brought into being on earth and what emerges from it; from the evil of the trials of night and day; and from the evil of every night visitor except one who comes with good, Ya Rahman (Most Merciful).
items.translit: Audhu bikalimatillahit-tammatil-lati la yujawizuhunna barrun wa la fajir, min sharri ma khalaqa wa baraa wa dharaa, wa min sharri ma yanzilu minas-sama, wa min sharri ma yaruju fiha, wa min sharri ma dharaa fil-ard, wa min sharri ma yakhruju minha, wa min sharri fitanil-layli wan-nahar, wa min sharri kulli tariqin illa tariqan yatruqu bikhayrin ya Rahman.

items.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.tr: Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, said: By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: People, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him one hundred times a day.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Whoever says, 'I seek forgiveness from Allah, Al-Azim (the Magnificent), none is worthy of worship except Him, Al-Hayy (the Ever-Living), Al-Qayyum (the Sustainer of all), and I repent to Him,' Allah will forgive him even if he fled from the battlefield.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: The Lord is nearest to the servant in the latter part of the night. If you can be among those who remember Allah at that hour, then be among them.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: A servant is closest to his Lord while prostrating, so make abundant dua (supplication).

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: A veil sometimes comes over my heart, and I seek Allah's forgiveness one hundred times a day.

items.ar: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْر)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Whoever says 'Glory and praise be to Allah' one hundred times a day will have his sins removed, even if they are like the foam of the sea.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ، كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Whoever says ten times, 'None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things,' is like someone who freed four persons from the descendants of Ismail.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Two phrases are light on the tongue, heavy on the scales and beloved to Ar-Rahman (the Most Merciful): Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah, Al-Azim (the Magnificent).

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لَأَنْ أَقُولَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمسُ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Saying 'Glory be to Allah; all praise belongs to Allah; none is worthy of worship except Allah; Allah is greatest' is dearer to me than all upon which the sun rises.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُم أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ)) فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: ((يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ، فَيُكتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Is any of you unable to earn one thousand good deeds every day? Someone sitting with him asked: How can one of us earn one thousand good deeds? He said: Glorify Allah one hundred times, and one thousand good deeds will be recorded for him or one thousand sins removed from him.

items.ar: ((مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ)).
items.tr: Whoever says 'Glory and praise be to Allah, Al-Azim (the Magnificent)' will have a palm tree planted for him in Paradise.

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ))؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: ((قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Abdullah ibn Qays, shall I direct you to a treasure among the treasures of Paradise? I said: Yes, Messenger of Allah. He said: Say, 'There is no power or strength except through Allah.'

items.ar: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأتَ)).
items.tr: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: The words most beloved to Allah are four: Glory be to Allah; all praise belongs to Allah; none is worthy of worship except Allah; Allah is greatest. It does not matter which you begin with.

items.ar: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلاماً أَقُولُهُ: قَالَ: ((قُلْ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ)) قَالَ: فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي، فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: ((قُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي)).
items.tr: A Bedouin came to Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, and said: Teach me words to say. He said: Say, 'None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. Allah is supremely great. Abundant praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power or strength except through Allah, Al-Aziz (the Almighty), Al-Hakim (the All-Wise).' He said: These are for my Lord; what is for me? He said: Say, 'O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me and provide for me.'

items.ar: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي)).
items.tr: When a man accepted Islam, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, taught him salah (prayer), then instructed him to supplicate with these words: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being and provide for me.

items.ar: ((إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَأَفْضَلَ الذِّكْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ)).
items.tr: The best dua (supplication) is 'All praise belongs to Allah,' and the best dhikr (remembrance) is 'None is worthy of worship except Allah.'

items.ar: الباقيات الصالحات : سبحان الله والحمد لله ، ولا إله إلا الله ،والله أكبر ،و لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
items.tr: The enduring righteous deeds: Glory be to Allah; all praise belongs to Allah; none is worthy of worship except Allah; Allah is greatest; there is no power or strength except through Allah.
items.translit: Subhanallah, walhamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

items.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنه قَالَ: ((رَأَيْتُ النَّبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ)) وفي زيادةٍ: ((بِيَمِينِهِ)).
items.tr: Abdullah ibn Amr, may Allah be pleased with him, said: I saw the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, counting glorifications on his fingers. Another wording adds: With his right hand.

items.ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ((إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ – أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُم – فَـكُفُّوا صِبْيانَـكُم، فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ، وَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَاباً مُغلَقاً، وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُم، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئاً، وَأَطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيحَكُمْ)).
items.tr: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: When night begins, or evening comes, keep your children in, for devils spread out then. When a portion of the night has passed, let them go. Close the doors and mention Allah's name, for Satan does not open a closed door. Tie your waterskins and mention Allah's name; cover your vessels and mention Allah's name, even if only by placing something across them; and extinguish your lamps.

items.ar: أذكار الصباح
items.tr: Morning adhkar (remembrances)

items.ar: ((أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي  هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ)).
items.tr: We have entered the morning, and all dominion belongs to Allah. All praise belongs to Allah. None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and what follows it, and seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and what follows it.
